honest_framing: A classifier trained on a real cohort, scoring de-novo generated structures. High predicted activity is NOT evidence of efficacy. The only defensible reading is distributional: are the generated molecules in-distribution for these activity models or not.

framing: DISTRIBUTIONAL ONLY. The NCI-60 heads reach MEASURED test AUC 0.7617-0.9549 (per-cell, 5 seeds, 50 epochs, scaffold split) on REAL data, and here they score the GENERATED molecules at 0.609 against 0.4273 on that same real cohort through the identical code path. This does NOT mean the generated structures are predicted anticancer agents. MEASURED: the training cohort carries a precious metal in 0/7823 molecular graphs (the metal sits in a separate MetalCytoToxDB column that is never joined into the graph), while 37/37 generated molecules DO carry one. The model was fitted on metal-free graphs and is scoring metal-bearing ones. The number answers 'where do these de-novo structures sit relative to real measured complexes under this model', nothing about efficacy. [UPDATE 2026-10-31: the 0.609-vs-0.4273 contrast is the 37-row era-A RECONSTRUCTION cohort scored against the real cohort, both retained unchanged. It is not a measurement of the current 66-row era-B free-generation pool, whose cross-application numbers are UNMEASURED because the checkpoint family is not on disk. The metal-audit sentence is re-measured and still holds for the 66-row pool (66/66 metal-bearing).]
caveats: n=37 generated molecules. The per-cell spread (A549 0.8335 vs A2780 0.4010) is within what 37 draws can produce by chance; do not read per-cell structure into it. [UPDATE 2026-10-31: these 37 are the SUPERSEDED era-A reconstruction cohort; the current pool at that path has 66 rows of free generation and is UNMEASURED for this metric.]

The reference column scores BELOW 0.5 on 6/9 cell lines. That is not a calibration success: mean predicted probability tracks the cohort's 0.3818 active base rate, so the delta is partly a base-rate artefact of comparing against a cohort that is 38% active, not evidence of predicted activity.

featurizer z_onehot omits Ru(44)/Os(76)/Re(75), so 17/37 generated molecules carry a metal indistinguishable from any other unlisted element. [UPDATE 2026-10-31: on the 66-row era-B pool the corresponding count is 33/66 (Z 44, 75, 76), re-measured via the same metal_audit function.]
Per-cell reference pools are capped at --reference-limit (400); small cells (DU145 161 unique, SKOV3 191) are fully covered, large ones are subsampled.

provenance_correction_2026_10_11.second_problem: n_generated=37 is far too small for a per-cell-line mean over 5 seeds, independent of the provenance issue.

On the 66-row era-B pool the per-cell spread is UNMEASURED (no checkpoints).]
provenance_correction_2026_10_11.do_not_claim: That the generator produces anticancer-active structures. gen_validity for FREE generation is 0.23-0.38; this cohort is seeded-geometry reconstruction.
